about: Which types count as answers to each Warden, and how they may be handed out before that gym (SPINE Revision 16, design/DISTRIBUTION_STUDY.md section 4). Read by tools/validate_encounters.py, tools/validate_badge_tiers.py and tools/harness/run_trials.rb. A Warden without 'answers' is not checked yet: set its entry when its team is built (rule R9).

rules.evolution_aware: a species counts as every type its level-up line reaches at or below the Warden's level cap
rules.gift_kinds: gifts, guaranteed battles (duels, chases, statics), boss rewards, eggs and in-game trades
rules.wild: gated answers to Warden N: at most rare_slot_pct of one encounter table and rare_table_pct in total, on every table the player can use before Gym N (segment and method unlock < N); 'zero' types: none at all
rules.gifts: nothing obtainable while holding b badges (b >= N - gift_horizon, b < N) may have a type in 'answers' of Warden N, gated or blunted
rules.blunted: answers the Warden's field and team are built to beat; they may stay common in the wild (Reborn: birds before Shelly; Rejuvenation: Grass before Valarie) but are never gifted inside the horizon
rules.own_type_fliers: optional per Warden ('own_type_fliers': true): a flier that shares the Warden's type is gated instead of blunted. Not used for Tamsin: Elowen's early bug lines (Butterfree, Beautifly, Vivillon) are Bug-type fliers by Lv 10-12, and Tamsin's Joltik answers every flier with Electroweb on wet silk
rules.pseudo_legends: rule R7: no pseudo-legend line in a wild table or overlay the player can use with fewer than pseudo_legend_min_badges badges (Reborn and Rejuvenation: none wild before Badge 12-16 of 18); earlier ones only as earned rewards (quest, boss, puzzle, egg), at most one per Act and never before Badge 4
rules.exempt: the Prologue starter pick (any Gen 1-9 starter) and story Pokemon given back to the player

wardens.why: Reborn's first gym model: no Ground at all before Julia (Electric), the first Ground types (Numel, Onyx) are handed out right after her badge. Fighting is Dorian's weakness and Ghost is immune to Normal.

Reborn keeps wild Fire out until Pyrous Mountain (after Gym 4) and gates its Fire types behind a boss (Litleo), weather + snax (Numel, Pansear) and trade chains (Castform). Silkwood burns under 3 Fire moves, so Fire is the premium answer. Non-Bug fliers lose 20% on Silkwood and Tamsin's lead Joltik spreads Electroweb (x1.5, never misses) over wet silk: Flying is blunted, like Shelly's Rain against Fire.

Water Surface boosts Electric x1.5 against grounded targets (premium answer). Grass is Elowen's own type; Water Surface slows grounded non-Water Pokemon (x0.75 Speed) and stops Grassy Terrain, and Pelipper, Araquanid and Gyarados beat Grass (Rejuvenation's Valarie faces common wild Grass the same way).
Ground hits Electric super-effectively and is immune to it: the Julia rule one act later.
